items.summary: Audit corrections must propagate to every doc occurrence, not just discoveries — grep all docs.
items.description: When an audit catches drift (line counts, file existence, API shape), the correction must propagate to ALL doc claims, not just where I first wrote it. Discoveries in context/ are not enough — grep -rn the docs for the stale fact and fix every occurrence. 'I noted it in discoveries' is not the same as 'the docs are correct.' PR #379 Copilot review found 13 comments all tracing back to this failure: context knew the right facts, but multiple doc files still claimed the old ones.

items.summary: Test counts must come from npm test summary line, not grep — status.md claimed 323 vs actual 298.
items.description: The status.md test count (323) was wrong. Grep for 'tests' in the vitest output is not reliable — run npm test and read the summary line. Actual: 298 tests, 14 files.

items.summary: Verify a commit is on main with git branch --contains before claiming it shipped.
items.description: Before claiming a commit is on main, run: git log --oneline origin/main | grep <hash>. Or: git branch --contains <hash>. The 15f232e commit was only on the PR branch.

items.summary: Always re-grep legacy comment count in LobbyView.tsx live; cached numbers go stale fast.
items.description: The legacy comment count changes as refactoring happens. Always grep -c 'legacy' src/components/LobbyView.tsx rather than relying on a cached number. Was 41 at PR #379 creation, 26 on current branch as of 2026-05-02.
